# Object Coverage

The [example-object table](example-object-union.md) classifies every canonical type in the current file corpus. This full registry also retains reviewed objects outside that corpus.

Input handling and compiler typing are separate from actual Source admission. Legacy `typed` status means a reviewed input projection; the explicit compiler column alone states whole-object TypedModel coverage. A real raw getter is not a typed model, an inactive declaration is not active simulation, and a blocked typed graph is not runtime support. No category means full-object support or promotes numerical conformance. Code review references establish implementation/admission facts; first evidence can be a unit/code reference rather than an Oracle comparison. Exact fields, remaining consumers and numerical claims remain bounded by the registry and promoted manifests.
